horizon.ruleEditNote: Custom rules locked all horizon: 'Meet Bloat Mother / 72h elapsed / or 120h elapsed', then '72h elapsed / or 120h elapsed' after Bloat Mother. Zero completed edits. Configuration changes made instead: styles, extra tactics, personality, forge, legacy, workers.
horizon.notes: Watches at normal speed (Orin, Iris, Dara, Elian, Quill, Fenn, Orin Thorn) and Fights-only (Iris D3-D13 warlord+mother run, Orin Thorn). 8h phase ~19.9 of 20 min after honest exclusions; total 70.4.

killCriteria.notes: defaultRulesBeatEveryEdit not assessable by hand: rule writing never unlocked; packaged tactic choices visibly moved forecasts (D13 63%->88%, D14 <13%->100%+87).

sameDayRetelling: Iris Thorn, my second bloodline, had been turned back twice by the Goblin Warlord at D8 until I switched her to Guarded and the town trained a warlord counter; on the next run 'GOBLIN WARLORD DOWN' flashed and she ran straight through the Fens to D13 with $2442 secured, where she met the Bloat Mother and limped home at 6/30 hp with $3144. Two absences later the chronicle told me she had died at D8 to a goblin archer ('return at 25% too late'), and her line went on to lose five more heirs to gas, fire and an iron golem. I picked boss focus for that line, and its third heir burned himself to death: 'own fire · D13 · hero at 5 hp · boss focus'.

humanProbes.clarity: Mostly yes: the forecast told me 'D13 · mother 63%±34' became '88%±12' after I picked kite archers, but 'compare outcomes' only ever said 'deeper ≈+90' with no unit and a death lever read 'WAIT Guarded L5'.
humanProbes.decisions: After two archer deaths ('goblin archer · D8 · hero at 1 hp') I gave the third bloodline kite archers and iron gut, and I would do it again; forge purchases were just 'buy next when affordable'.
humanProbes.mastery: I learned that archers and gas kill my fighters and that corridor fighting lifted D14 from <13% to '100%+87', but I never got to write a row ('Custom rules · locked · 72h elapsed').
humanProbes.tension: I sweated watching Dara at '1/36 hp' still 'Heading home' with unknown potions in her pack, and she died: 'goblin archer · D4 · hero at 2 hp'.
humanProbes.feel: Callouts like 'OGRE WINDS UP', 'SHIELDS UP' and 'GOBLIN WARLORD DOWN' landed, but the log is buried in 'goblin → Iris Thorn · −0 hp' lines; audio unassessed.
humanProbes.surprise: 'own fire · D13 · hero at 5 hp' surprised me and made me drop boss focus for corridor fighting; gas deaths then repeated ('gas ×3').
humanProbes.expression: Every hero was a fighter in Guarded with nearly the same tactics, so the three lines read as one build with different epithets ('the chokepoint fighter', 'the greedy fighter').
humanProbes.story: '♟2 the chokepoint fighter · D12 · took the Warlord · found ♟1's bones · fell to a wraith' is a real little saga.
humanProbes.pacing: Runs watch in about a minute ('D1–10 · 100% · +$256' skips the shallow floors) and returns take a few minutes, but each check-in repeats forge/legacy/tactics chores across three bloodlines and heroes 'Resting 20m' unless I tap SEND.
humanProbes.failure: Deaths name foe, depth, hp and rule ('wraith · D12 · hero at 2 hp · Guarded · attack nearest') and the reel adds 'return at 25% too late', but the offered fix was often 'BUY pack 4'.
humanProbes.social: Nobody; heirs and named grudges ('grudge: Vrar the goblin archer') are flavour, not relationships.
humanProbes.autonomy: I chose which bloodline to fund and which to SEND, but the route and goals were the game's ('Goal D14 · New record').
humanProbes.progression: Automation grew every few runs (porter, scout, apprentice 'buys forge steps', keeper, drillmaster '+3 levels'), but depth stalled at 'best D20' from the 4h return through the whole 8h return while Legacy piled to 80.
humanProbes.aesthetic: A lamp-lit pixel town at night and a torn red 'YOU DIED' banner with the killer's portrait; I would sit in the town.
humanProbes.return: I came back to 'While away · 12 RUNS · D20 · $16947 · Boss defeated Lich' and two heirs to read about, and decided to add corridor fighting; after 8h it was '22 RUNS · D20' again with less to decide.
humanProbes.attribution: Kael died because I gave his line boss focus ('own fire · boss focus · tactic boss focus') — that one was mine; the Warlord kill felt mine too, but with seven heirs per line most deaths felt like the bloodline's, not my rule's.

axes.note: Forecast panel shows per-floor odds that move after choices ('D13 63%±34' -> '88%±12'). Lapses: 'deeper ≈+90' unitless, lever 'WAIT Guarded L5', 'behind mother' shown after the Mother was defeated, rest timers bypassed by SEND, deeper legacy tree hidden under 'More upgrades'.
Style/tactic/personality picks had foreseeable trade-offs (kite archers after archer deaths, corridor fighting: D14 '<13%' -> '100%+87'); forge and legacy were strictly ordered buys.
Learned killers (archers, gas, iron golem) and countered with packaged tactics, but rule writing stayed locked ('72h elapsed') all horizon; drillmaster levelled tactics for me.
Dara at '1/36 hp · Heading home' died to an archer; carry at risk ('returned $150 · keeps 60%'). After 4h most stakes resolved offline.
Readable callouts ('OGRE WINDS UP', 'REST ✗ NOT SAFE', 'GOBLIN WARLORD DOWN'); 3x GPU smooth; lapse: log spam of '−0 hp' lines and black interstitial screens. Audio unassessed.
Thieves den ('THIEVES! The den wakes'), captives, own-fire death, Bloat Mother/Lich; later deaths repeated gas ×3 and iron golem wall.
All three lines ended as Guarded fighters with corridor fighting plus one of boss focus/kite archers; rules list differs by one or two rows.
Chronicle carries setup/turn/end ('took the Warlord · found ♟1's bones · fell to a wraith'); epithets add colour; story is told in summaries rather than witnessed.

In-run: ~1 min per watched run, shallow floors summarised. Check-in: 3-6 min but repeated forge/legacy/tactics admin x3 bloodlines; heroes 'Resting 20m' unless SEND tapped. Cadence: 20m vs 4h distinct, 4h vs 8h similar.
Every death screen: killer portrait, 'D12 · hero at 2 hp', firing rule, lever; reel 'return at 25% too late'. Lapse: lever often generic ('BUY pack 4', 'WAIT Guarded L5').
Choice of which bloodline to fund/send; goals and route are fixed by records and bosses.

Three layers seen: within-run depth, persistent legacy/forge, automation cadence (porter, scout, apprentice, keeper, drillmaster all within 70 min). Lapse: best D20 unchanged from 4h through 8h return; Legacy 80 with no visible sink; forge prices outran income.
Night pixel town with lit windows, torn red death banner with killer portrait, boss cards. Lapse: watch view frequently a black screen with a floor title; audio unassessed.
20m: deaths to read and levers; 4h: '12 RUNS · D20 · $16947 · Lich' plus new tactic to place; 8h: '22 RUNS · D20', same wall, fewer decisions (legacy maxed).

Some deaths traced to my picks ('own fire · boss focus · tactic boss focus'; iron gut row 'unknown item · hp > 60% → drink unknown'), but no player-written rule existed and seven heirs per line diluted ownership.

blindnessViolations: None known. Read only RATING.md, FUN_EVAL_IDLE.md, FRAMEWORK.md §1-3 (printed up to §4 heading), the template and eval/presets.json idle-hybrid weights (needed for preset).
